Name: DE-TypologyGroupsCompanies
Description: Extracts typology grous associated to companies
Statement:
select  tgd.Oid as Id,
        utg.Oid as TypologyGroupId,
        utg.Name as TypologyGroup,
        com.Id as CompanyId,
        com.Name as Company
from    UserTypologyGroupCompany tgd
            join CompanyLookup com on com.Id = tgd.Company
            join UserTypologyGroup utg on utg.Oid = tgd.UserTypologyGroup
